column2: Provides field based and remote sensing data sets to the Jordan Valley authority in Jordan. these are to be used to derive indicators for calculating water per kg of food produced.
The tool integrates data on weather forecasts, transpiration, and soils moisture to offer practical advice to farmers on how to optimally use water for irrigation.
It calculates decadal water use by comparing actual evapotranspiration with precipitation, enabling precise estimation of irrigation water use at different scales and time periods

Using satellite and groundtruthed data, the tool monitors and forecasts drought in Pakistan and provides this information to government agencies and rural communities to help in putting in place mitigation measures
The tool help compute agricultural water use, crop water requirements, and assessment of irrigation performance indicators.
